strategies.name: The 10x study (first stage of the 100x aim): early evidence, not past winners
strategies.explain: Pre-specify first: 10x = sustained (close held 10x for 20+ sessions), adjusted prices, min 2 USD and 200k shares/day at the start, whole market incl. dead stocks. For every 10x winner in 5 years record what was visible 12, 6 and 3 months BEFORE the move, using only data dated then, in six families: business acceleration (revenue growth, margins, guidance), commercial proof (named customers, contracts, capacity), survival and dilution (runway, share count, warrants), market position, early market recognition (relative strength, accumulation), and failure fingerprints. Then build the look-alike group: companies with the same visible profile on the same dates that did NOT run, and count how many went to zero or delisted. Output is a precursor scorecard (how many winners found, how many false positives, capital lost following them), not a buy rule. A rule follows only if the profile is rare among non-winners and survives the normal gates with months-long holds and the loss-line exit. No re-fitting the profile against the same winners.

strategies.name: Hot layer of an active chain: buy the members of the 3 strongest chain layers (3-month return vs S&P 500) that are above their 50-day average; hold 1 month
strategies.explain: The owner, 23 Oct 2026: "AI needs cloud services, it is a chain; follow the source." Built on chain-ripple: the edge was in being a chain member during a strong theme, not in a one-day jump. RULE: every 21 sessions from session 70 of the cache, each layer of every chain (a chain+layer pair) scores the AVERAGE 63-session return of its point-in-time members that have a close on both days, minus the S&P 500 (SPY) over the same 63 sessions; a layer needs 3+ such members. Rank all layers; take the TOP 3. BUY at the next open every point-in-time member of those 3 layers that passes the gates and closes above its own 50-session average (equal weight; a stock in two top layers is bought once). SELL at the close 21 sessions after the signal. No stop. SAME STOCK ON OTHER DAYS = the same stock's 21-session result from the other rebalance dates of the same half on which it was a point-in-time member of at least one layer and NONE of its layers was top 3 (3+ such months needed; otherwise that trade has no own-yardstick). strategies.name: Repetition: does one chain layer lead another by a month? Pairs learned on the FIRST half only, traded on the SECOND half only
strategies.explain: The owner's sources claim AI leadership moved down the stack by scarcity (2023 chip designers, 2024 power and networking, 2025-26 memory, optics and equipment); this tests whether such an order repeats and can be traded.
